ref_file_title: FO99 - Secure Integration of Asymmetric and Symmetric Encryption Schemes
note: Introduces the Fujisaki-Okamoto transform: a one-way (gamma-uniform) asymmetric scheme plus a one-time-secure symmetric scheme give an IND-CCA hybrid PKE in the ROM; the KEM form is later (Den03, HHK17). cryptobib_key: C:FujOka99. Journal version: J. Cryptology 26(1):80-101, 2013, doi:10.1007/s00145-011-9114-1 (cryptobib JC:FujOka13). Do not confuse with the same authors' PKC 1999 paper 'How to Enhance the Security of Public-Key Encryption at Minimum Cost' (cryptobib PKC:FujOka99), a different transform; if that paper is ever added it needs a suffixed key.

ref_file_title: FOPS01 - RSA-OAEP Is Secure under the RSA Assumption
authors: Eiichiro Fujisaki, Tatsuaki Okamoto, David Pointcheval, Jacques Stern
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib C:FOPS01 (CRYPTO 2001, LNCS 2139, pp. 260-274, doi 10.1007/3-540-44647-8_16) and search snippets; journal version J. Cryptology 17(2):81-104, 2004. Proves RSA-OAEP IND-CCA secure in the ROM under partial-domain one-wayness, hence under the RSA assumption. cryptobib_key: C:FOPS01.

ref_file_title: Fis03 - The Cramer-Shoup Strong-RSA Signature Scheme Revisited
note: cryptobib key PKC:Fischlin03 (title, author, pages 116-129, LNCS 2567, DOI verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib; Springer/Fraunhofer records confirmed via search snippets). Variant of Cramer-Shoup under strong RSA with faster signing and verification and signatures of roughly half the size.
